title: Emmabyte's Cobblemon Max
description: Train, build, and battle in style—Cobblemon Max combines expanded Cobblemon features, RPG combat, world upgrades, and stunning visuals into the ultimate Pokémon-in-Minecraft adventure.
body:
**Emmabyte’s Cobblemon Max** is a fully standalone Cobblemon experience designed to bring your Pokémon journey in Minecraft to the next level. This pack brings together a hand-picked set of mods across five core areas:

- **Cobblemon & Add-ons**: A wide suite of Cobblemon-centered mods expands the trainer experience—badges, in-game currency, alpha spawns, integrations, Poképedia, UI tweaks, rideable Cobblemon, breeding systems, new trainers, and even myths and legends.

- **Visual Upgrades**: Shaders, particle effects, and fresh animations breathe new life into your world, making every battle and journey look cinematic.

- **World & Building**: From Terralith landscapes to new furniture, taverns, paintings, and custom structures, the world feels alive and full of building potential.

- **Combat & Progression**: RPG-inspired mechanics like runes, skill trees, and shield improvements give battles more depth and long-term goals.

- **Quality of Life**: Essentials and other tweaks smooth out the overall gameplay experience.

Whether you’re here to train the rarest Cobblemon, build immersive towns, or take on RPG-style combat challenges, Cobblemon Max has everything you need for an adventure that feels bigger, bolder, and uniquely yours.
